name: pstack-for-codex
description: Codex adaptation of pstack engineering principles, playbooks, reviews and verification workflows.

interface.longDescription: A Codex adaptation of Lauren Tan’s MIT-licensed pstack. Includes all core skills, principles, playbooks and role prompts. Uses available native tools, inherited models and explicit sequential fallbacks. No Cursor automation, MCP server or cloud runner is provisioned.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use pstack-for-codex:poteto-mode to investigate, implement and verify this task.
